facts.description: Small, tested toolkit for diffing and normalising CSV/TSV files (demo data)

readme.text:
# tablekit

Diff and normalise CSV/TSV files. MIT, stdlib only.

## Install

pip install tablekit

## Quickstart

tablekit diff a.csv b.csv --json

## CLI

Full flag list in `docs/cli.md`. Output defaults to JSON.

## How it works

The comparison is a set diff over normalised column signatures. Sample datasets
live in `demo/` so every result in this README can be reproduced offline.

## Testing

pytest -q: 118 tests, CI on 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12. Coverage is reported per PR.

## Benchmarks

On a 50k-row sheet the diff takes 2.1s (see `benchmarks/`). The previous
release took 4.8s; the changelog records both numbers and the method.
